comparator_commit: [replace: output of git rev-parse HEAD in your comparator checkout]
lean4export_commit: [replace: optional; output of git rev-parse HEAD in your lean4export checkout, or delete this line]
landrun_commit: [replace: optional; output of git rev-parse HEAD in your landrun checkout, or delete this line]
wall_time_seconds: [replace: elapsed seconds, as a number without quotes]

machine.ram_gb: [replace: memory in GB, as a number without quotes]

contributor.name: [replace: your full name, as it should appear on the site]

log_sha256: [replace: the first field printed by sha256sum comparator.log]
notes: [replace: optional; anything unusual, for example a change to lake-manifest.json after lake update, or delete this line]
